tasks.title: Rebuild SimCAT 2 DILR Q1–5: rooms and instruments
tasks.reason: Three wrong outputs from a short grouping set are the largest repeated accuracy loss.
steps: Cold-attempt the five questions from a blank page before solutions. Use one row per room with instructor and two instrument slots.
Audit all clues, instructor uniqueness and exactly two of each instrument. Keep deductions separate from assumptions.
Compare the official model. Locate the first mismatch that caused Q1/Q2/Q5 to be wrong.
tasks.completion: All five outcomes and the first wrong inference or extraction step are explained.

tasks.title: Cold-attempt SimCAT 2 QA Q11/Q15/Q17/Q9
tasks.reason: SI/CI and Mixtures are repeatedly unconverted; unseen TSD/Work may be recoverable.
steps: Attempt SI/CI Q11, TSD Q15, Work Q17 and Mixtures Q9 without notes or solutions.
Then inspect official methods and explain the blocking step. Zero-time Q15/Q17 are untested ability, not established concept gaps.
tasks.completion: Four cold outcomes reported; identify which need knowledge, route or calculation repair.

tasks.title: Diagnose SimCAT 2 DILR player-selection set Q19–22
tasks.reason: This easy-by-cohort set was never reached. Establish recoverability rather than assuming a weakness.
steps: Cold-attempt all four unseen questions, then check the solution.
If independent, solve one fresh grouping set from an unused IMS sectional/PYQ. If blocked, use the official model as one guided example, then solve one easier fresh grouping set.
tasks.completion: Unseen-set outcome plus one fresh transfer set reviewed.

tasks.title: Repair SimCAT 2 QA Q3 Surds and Q2 Mensuration
tasks.reason: These two questions consumed 19:11 for net 2 marks.
steps: Cold-redo both questions, recording setup and computation separately.
Compare the shortest understandable official route. Solve three fresh similar questions per topic from AzuCATion/IMS.
Use a narrowly matched VERITAS segment only if concept failure persists.
tasks.completion: Both routes reconstructed and six fresh outcomes reported.

tasks.title: SI/CI repair: 10 fresh questions after Q11 diagnostic
tasks.reason: SI/CI is unconverted in all three recorded mocks.
steps: Use AzuCATion CAT PYQs Simple & Compound Interest: first 10 unused questions (15-question bank previously indexed). If unavailable use IMS SI/CI practice.
If Q11 and fresh questions show a concept gap, open VERITAS SubWise G3:H5 and study only the missing segment, then retry.
If all are clean, replace extra SI/CI volume with five TSD and five Work questions.
tasks.completion: 10 fresh outcomes and misses redone; source and stopping point reported.

tasks.title: Rebuild SimCAT 2 DILR Table Q6–9 and test transfer
tasks.reason: 4/4 correct is promising, but 26:59 leaves little capacity elsewhere.
steps: Re-solve Q6–9; separate information extraction, table setup and calculations.
Compare the official setup and reuse quantities once. Solve one fresh Table/conditional-DI set without hints.
Judge progress from fresh accuracy and route, not the speed of the familiar redo.
tasks.completion: One reviewed redo plus a fresh set completed or blocked step identified.

tasks.title: VARC Summary check within mock review
tasks.reason: Across three mocks Summary is 0/6 converted, while overall VARC remains >93 percentile.
steps: Cold-redo SimCAT 2 Q13/Q17, state each paragraph's main claim before comparing options.
Then attempt four fresh IMS Summary questions; only if fewer than three are correct, add one six-question repair batch at the next weekly review.
tasks.completion: Two redos and four fresh outcomes reported.

tasks.title: Arithmetic transfer: 15 questions SI/CI, Mixtures, TSD and Work
tasks.reason: Distinguishes taught knowledge from usable mixed-question performance.
steps: Use fresh questions: 4 SI/CI, 4 Mixtures, 4 TSD, 3 Work from accessible AzuCATion/IMS banks.
Attempt before lessons. Review all misses. For a repeated concept gap use the exact matching VERITAS lesson and then two new applications.
Redo 16 October failures after the review.
tasks.completion: 15 fresh outcomes plus due redos reported.

tasks.title: Fresh DILR grouping pair with clue audit
tasks.reason: Fresh transfer tests whether the 3-error model failure was repaired.
steps: Solve two fresh grouping sets: one allocation, one selection. Use unused IMS sectional/PYQ sets.
Before checking answers validate every clue against the final model; then answer each question from the model, not memory.
tasks.completion: Two complete audited models and answer outcomes reported.
